whenToUse: Every collection screen with more than a handful of rows: posts, contacts, invoices, employees.
Sorting, search, column visibility/pinning, selection with bulk actions, saved views and export.
Start from list-01 / list-02 / list-03 blocks.
avoidWhen: Small static tables (invoice lines, settings lists) — use Table.
Lists of rich rows without columns — use Item.
a11y: Sortable headers are buttons with aria-sort; the selection checkbox names its row.
The bulk bar announces the selection count; row actions menus name the record.
